definitions.explanation: The region of the atmosphere above the earth.

examples.english: To look up at the sky.

notes:
{空|そら} means sky.

NOTE ON READINGS:
- {空|そら}: sky
- {空|から}: empty
- {空|くう}: void, emptiness (Buddhist term)

COMPOUNDS:
- {青空|あおぞら}: blue sky
- {夜空|よぞら}: night sky
- {空港|くうこう}: airport
- {空気|くうき}: air
